message.content:
I need to verify the two source values directly before confirming the rounded result. I’m searching Wikipedia for the minimum lunar perigee and Kipchoge’s record time.
I’m using the verified Wikipedia figures—minimum perigee 356400 km and Kipchoge’s 2:01:09 marathon record—to compute the constant-speed travel time and round to the nearest 1000 hours.
The calculation is \(356400 \div (42.195 \div (2+1/60+9/3600))\); I’m evaluating it directly, then rounding to the requested thousand-hour precision.
17000 hours
